Time, kept quietly.

AK Watches is a small run of steel and shadow — dive bezels, open hearts, and clean three-hand dials, built for people who'd rather feel the hour than announce it.

16pieces in this drop
Quartz & automaticmovement families
Stainless & PVDcase finishes
A note from AK
Every watch here, I'd wear myself.

I started this out of a drawer full of watches that never quite fit — too loud, too fragile, too far from what an everyday piece should feel like. AK Watches is the drawer I wished I had: dive bezels that turn with a real click, dials with enough texture to catch the light, and cases sized for a wrist, not a display case.

Nothing here is precious. Wear it in the water, wear it to work, hand it down eventually. That's the whole idea.

— AK

Craft

Built to be worn, not shelved.

Every case is pressure-tested, every bezel clicks to a stop, and every bracelet is sized before it ships. We keep the specs plain because a watch should tell you the time — the rest is just good manners.
